weightingMethod: For each feature, blend 70% shrinkage-adjusted clean-15-minute lift with 30% shrinkage-adjusted by-noon lift; normalize only positive evidence to 100. These are exploratory univariate weights, not independent model coefficients.

definitions.absorptionProxy: Prior 30 seconds are sell-imbalanced, yet price loses no more than 5% of one ORB range and the following 30 seconds recover. This indicates limited downside progress under selling; it does not prove hidden limit-order absorption.
definitions.acceptedReclaim30Seconds: The following 30 seconds finish above 0.70 without trading more than 5% of one ORB range below it.
definitions.falseReclaim30Seconds: The following 30 seconds finish below 0.70 after trading more than 5% of one ORB range below it.
definitions.accepted70FiveMinutes: No price-forming trade more than 5% of one ORB range below 0.70 during the next five minutes.
definitions.falseReclaimFiveMinutes: A price-forming trade moves more than 10% of one ORB range below 0.70 during the next five minutes.
definitions.orbHighRejection: After the ORB high is touched, the fifth subsequent one-minute close is below the ORB high.
